name: Radio Reach Vault radio station contact directory
description: A point-in-time research compilation of publicly discoverable radio station programming contacts — station, city, region, country, contact name, role, email and phone — organized for direct artist outreach.
$note: Metadata describing the commercial contact dataset. The dataset itself is paid and is not exposed here. A free structural sample showing the field schema is published at https://radioreach.us/sample/
